## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The variant prompt no longer names the scoring phases, and a held-out check...

The system SHALL ensure that the variant prompt no longer names the scoring phases, and a held-out check set the variants never saw is scored after they finish.

#### Scenario: The variant prompt no longer names the scoring phases, and a held-out check...

WHEN `apply-arena-discipline-to-prototype-feature` is implemented
THEN The variant prompt no longer names the scoring phases, and a held-out check set the variants never saw is scored after they finish.

### Requirement: When enabled, the judge's model family, resolved from archetypes.yaml tiers,...

The system SHALL ensure that when enabled, the judge's model family, resolved from archetypes.yaml tiers, differs from every variant's, and its recommendation is recorded beside the human pick in prototype-findings.md; the pick itself stays human.

#### Scenario: When enabled, the judge's model family, resolved from archetypes.yaml tiers,...

WHEN `apply-arena-discipline-to-prototype-feature` is implemented
THEN When enabled, the judge's model family, resolved from archetypes.yaml tiers, differs from every variant's, and its recommendation is recorded beside the human pick in prototype-findings.md; the pick itself stays human.

### Requirement: Grafting from non-winning variants is limited to at most two named parts,...

The system SHALL ensure that grafting from non-winning variants is limited to at most two named parts, and the limit is enforced in the convergence step.

#### Scenario: Grafting from non-winning variants is limited to at most two named parts,...

WHEN `apply-arena-discipline-to-prototype-feature` is implemented
THEN Grafting from non-winning variants is limited to at most two named parts, and the limit is enforced in the convergence step.

### Requirement: Divergence past the threshold emits a reframe finding that /iterate-on-plan...

The system SHALL ensure that divergence past the threshold emits a reframe finding that /iterate-on-plan --prototype-context consumes.

#### Scenario: Divergence past the threshold emits a reframe finding that /iterate-on-plan...

WHEN `apply-arena-discipline-to-prototype-feature` is implemented
THEN Divergence past the threshold emits a reframe finding that /iterate-on-plan --prototype-context consumes.
